g.text: Top view · rotated relative to the previous layout · socket positions unchanged · routing guides only
QT sockets on left / right edges
QT sockets on left / right edges
Left 50 mm edge: CC2650 cable. Right 50 mm edge: sensor clamp pair. Module QT link loops above.
Ground: ADS G17 → MCP6002 pin 4 via J12; ADDR G20 → GND G17. Supply at J14 remains 3.3 V.
R1 uses the socket end positions provisionally. Larger body envelope is illustrative; measure before mounting.
ADC A0 is now B20 and A1 is B19. Longer analog routes go around the module; power pins face U1.
Check before soldering: resistor body clearance and room for the right-side cable strain relief.
Crossing dashed lines are not connections. Use insulated wires; finalize underside routes after confirmation.
Board: 70 × 50 mm; 24 × 18 grid; Ø1 holes; Ø2 mounts. Grid centering / mounting offsets remain assumed.
Right edge: 50 mm · strain relief at exit
